Phase changes: 450 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of $Ag_{2}S$ ; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.953$ kcal/mol. 860 K, $\beta - \gamma$ transition point of $\mathrm{Ag}_2\mathrm{S}$ ; $\Delta \mathrm{H}^{\circ} = 0.179 \mathrm{kcal} / \mathrm{mol}$ . 1110 K, melting point of $Ag_{2}S$ ; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.860$ kcal/mol. 1235.08 K, melting point of Ag; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 2.700$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations:
298.15-450 K: $Cp^o$ = 18.411 + 4.980x $10^{-3}$ T - 1.489x $10^5$ T $^{-2}$
450-860 K: $H^o$ - $H_{298}^o$ = 18.411x $10^{-3}$ T + 2.490x $10^{-6}$ T $^2$ + 1.489x $10^2$ T $^{-1}$ - 6.210 $Cp^o$ = 19.800
860-1110 K: $H^o$ - $H_{298}^o$ = 19.800x $10^{-3}$ T - 5.047 $Cp^o$ = 19.800
1110-1400 K: $H^o$ - $H_{298}^o$ = 19.800x $10^{-3}$ T - 4.868 $Cp^o$ = 22.200
$H^o$ - $H_{298}^o$ = 22.200x $10^{-3}$ T - 5.672
Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-450 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -24.435 + 3.696 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.494 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 159.150 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -24.435 - 3.696 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.494 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 79.575 \text{T}^{-1} + 39.179 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
450-860 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -23.271 + 5.085 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 1.996 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 10.250 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -23.271 - 5.085 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 1.996 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 5.125 \text{T}^{-1} + 44.327 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
860-1110 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -23.092 + 5.085 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 1.996 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 10.250 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -23.092 - 5.085 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 1.996 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 5.125 \text{T}^{-1} + 44.119 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1110-1235.08 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -23.896 + 7.485 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 1.996 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 10.250 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -23.896 - 7.485 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 1.996 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 5.125 \text{T}^{-1} + 61.672 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1235.08-1400 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -25.323 + 2.029 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.160 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 34.150 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -25.323 - 2.029 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 0.160 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 17.075 \text{T}^{-1} + 26.268 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K based on Kiukkola (69) and Thompson (117). Low-temperature heat capacities and entropy at 298 K based on Walsh (128). High-temperature data based on Thompson (116).
